questions: How many nano-SQUIDs did you fabricate and measure, and in how many did you see the global signatures (h/2e oscillations, diode reversal) and the spectral jumps? The text says "all examined devices" without a number.
Why were the others set aside? For example, were there improved-series devices with one working tunnel probe, or with two, beyond B and C?
Which ranges of field, field angle, back-gate voltage and temperature did you measure beyond the ones shown? A temperature series of the zero-field zero-bias peaks would be especially useful.
What does the second-best dual-probe dataset look like, for instance device B at another back-gate voltage in Fig. 3, or a fourth device if one exists?

Section C of the supplement, "Effects of measurement circuit", has a heading and no text in the version I read. What series and filter resistances sit in the two-terminal tunnel spectroscopy and nonlocal circuits, how were they calibrated, and did you correct for the circuit effects described by Martinez et al. (your supplementary Ref. [2])?

The Methods give tunnel resistances "typically exceeding 100 kΩ" (about 0.26 e^2/h), while the conductance in device A (Fig. S1) and device C (Fig. S2b) is of order 1 e^2/h. What were the TJ1 and TJ2 resistances in each device, and are A and C in the tunnelling regime?

For the end-to-end correlation in Fig. 4l and Fig. S3l: the sign of the third derivative at zero bias takes a value even where there is no peak. What smoothing, bias step and threshold separate a peak or dip from no feature, and how do the fractions change with them? This also bears on device C, where a zero-bias peak "was mostly absent" (Supp. p. 4) while Fig. S3l shows a strong increase of correlated peaks.

The diode efficiency of any flux-periodic SQUID vanishes at half a flux quantum (Ciaccia et al. show this in a trivial InAs SQUID). Have you compared Ic+(flux), Ic-(flux) and the diode efficiency with a non-topological SQUID model using your junction asymmetry, and which feature of the reversal (its abruptness, the Ic recovery) carries the topological reading?
